Use case: stylized-concept. Production concept art for a low-poly 2.5D platformer, World 3 FROST PEAKS. Match the supplied FIVE REALMS reference's third region: snowy stepped blue ice cliffs, faceted snow mountains, dark teal snow-covered firs, cyan ice crystal clusters, pointed ice castle, warm brown rope bridges. Clear simple volumes suitable for Blender low-poly meshes, restrained icy blue saturation, off-white snow, blue-grey rock, subtle warm amber lantern accents. Crisp readable contours and flat cel-like material regions, no photorealism, no noisy microtexture, no excessive bloom. All parts physically modelable. Keep consistent across sheets.
Asset type: wide landscape full-stage environment concept illustration, not an asset sheet. Reference image is mood and world identity only; do not reproduce its world-map labels or islands. Render a beautiful wide near-side-on 2.5D playable mountain traverse, camera looks across X-horizontal travel with a little visible depth: left snowy forest entry on chunky snow-capped cliffs, central staggered flat ice platforms crossing a deep crevasse and a short timber rope bridge, then ancient icy gate and compact majestic ice castle on the raised right plateau. Layer behind it full-dimensional blue glacier wall, snowy mountain ridge, a rock arch, very distant pale jagged peaks. Include firs, snow boulders, frozen shrubs, ice crystals, signposts, amber lantern posts, a small closed supply chest, cloth pennants, snow-topped broken pillars. Subtly show a rune pressure plate by gate and a crystal checkpoint beacon. Tiny snow slime and blue ice beetle as scale creatures only. Playable surfaces horizontal and clearly readable, no ramps needed. Low-poly charming adventure look, bright cold morning, soft shadows, no UI, no logo, no text. The composition is a proposed art direction not an exact existing level layout.

Add little separable-part diagrams at far right only if space permits. Warm-white background, large creatures, no environment, no human hands.

Create a clean landscape VFX DESIGN sheet 'FROST PEAKS / EFFECTS'. Eight horizontal rows with eight distinct effects, each row four animation keyframes labeled START / BUILD / PEAK / FADE and a rightmost COMPONENTS diagram. FX01 snow footstep puff: tiny offwhite powder bursts and small chunks. FX02 ice impact shatter: 3D angular cyan shards with pale impact ring. FX03 drifting snow gust: a tapered ribbon of translucent white wind and sparse dots, no giant screen-covering cloud. FX04 icicle fall and smash: one falling cyan icicle becoming shards and powder; separate hazard geometry from effect. FX05 cold breath/frost puff: small pale blue mist curling and dissolving. FX06 checkpoint activation: amber thin ring around cyan crystal and tiny sparks. FX07 rune gate activation: cyan snowflake rune lines illuminate outward, a light column and diamond particles settle. FX08 enemy defeat: small blue-white poof with 5 chunky crystal shards and a soft ring. Warm-grey solid background for readability, cyan/offwhite effects with restrained amber only checkpoint. Graphic flat cel-shaded particle shapes, no photoreal smoke, no backgrounds, no humanoid characters, no duplicate effects. On far right show isolated low-poly shard, soft particle quad, ribbon strip or ring mesh per effect for Blender/Unity production. Timeline images are conceptual keyframes, NOT a texture atlas. Each effect stays in its own row, avoid dense captions.
